questions.question:
**Directions: The given sentence contains a grammatical error. Identify the segment that contains the error.**

Not get into the car; it has not been cleaned inside.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**Not get**' i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the use of the adverb 'Not' at the beginning of the sentence is incorrect.
 
• The adverb 'not' is used to **form the negative with **the verbs be, do** and have** (auxiliary verb) and with verbs such as **can, must, will**, etc. (modal verbs).
 
• The word ''**Don't**'' should be used **in place of 'not'**.
 
• ''**Don't**'' is a **negative of the verb 'do'** that means **do not**. It is used **to order or suggest or command or advise not to do something**.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct sentence: ***Don't get** into the car; it has not been cleaned inside*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Not** is simply used to show negation.

 
 
• **Example:** *It is **not** beautiful*. — here it's used to just show that something is the opposite of beautiful.
 
 
 
• **Don't** is used to order or suggest or command or advise to not to do something.
 
 
• **Example:** ***Don't** close the door*. — here it is ordered or told not to close the door. To not do an action ''don't'' is used.

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिए गए वाक्य में adverb 'not' का प्रयोग गलत है।
 
• Adverb 'not' का उपयोग **क्रियाओं के साथ नकारात्मक बनाने के लिए** किया जाता है be, do और have (सहायक क्रिया) और क्रियाओं जैसे कि can, must, will, आदि (मोडल क्रिया)।
 
• 'Not' के स्थान पर ''Don't'' शब्द का प्रयोग करना चाहिए।
 
• ''Don't'', क्रिया 'do' का negative है जिसका अर्थ है **न करना**। इसका उपयोग **आदेश देने या सुझाव देने या कुछ न करने की सलाह देने के लिए **किया जाता है।

 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 है।

सही वाक्य: *Don't get into the car; it has not been cleaned inside*.

questions.question:
**Directions: The given sentence contains a grammatical error. Identify the segment that contains the error.**

The school usually starts at 8 a.m. and is closing at 3 p.m.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**is closing at 3 p.m.**' i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the use of the present continuous tense 'is closing **at 3 p.m**' is incorrect.
 
• We use the **present continuous** to talk about **actions that are happening at the present moment but will soon finish**.
 
 
• The **present continuous tense**: **to be (am, is, are) + verb (the present participle)**
 
 
 
• The given sentence is talking about a general routine of opening and closing times of the school.
 
• We use the **present simple tense** when we want to talk about **fixed habits or routines – things that don't change**.
 
 
• The **simple present tense** is formed by using **the root form or by adding ‑s or ‑es to the end**.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the **present simple tense ''closes at 3 p.m''** should be used **in place of** the **present continuous tense ''is closing **at 3 p.m**''**.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Correct sentence: *The school usually starts at 8 a.m. and **closes at 3 p.m***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिए गए वाक्य में, present continuous tense 'is closing at 3 p.m' गलत है।
 
• हम present continuous का उपयोग **उन कार्यों के बारे में** बात करने के लिए करते हैं **जो वर्तमान क्षण में हो रहे हैं लेकिन जल्द ही समाप्त हो जाएंगे**।
 
 
• Present continuous tense: to be (am, is, are) + verb (the present participle)
 
 
 
• दिया गया वाक्य **स्कूल के खुलने और बंद होने के समय की सामान्य दिनचर्या के बारे में बात कर रहा है**।
 
• हम present simple tense का उपयोग तब करते हैं **जब हम निश्चित आदतों या दिनचर्या के बारे में **बात करना चाहते हैं - ऐसी चीजें जो नहीं बदलती हैं।
 
 
• Simple present tense मूल रूप का उपयोग करके या अंत में s या ‑es जोड़कर बनता है।
 
 
 
• इसलिए, present continuous tense ''is closing at 3 p.m'' के स्थान पर present simple tense ''closes at 3 p.m'' का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए।

 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 है।

सही वाक्य: *The school usually starts at 8 a.m. and closes at 3 p.m*.

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

Astronomers consider the year 2020 to be eventful in the celestial world __until__ the four eclipses.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'because of.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the underlined segment, the use of the preposition 'until' is incorrect.
 
• The preposition 'until' means **up to the time or the event mentioned**.
 
• The given sentence is telling **why the Astronomers consider the year 2020 to be eventful**.
 
• Therefore, the **preposition ''because of''** should be used **in place of** the **preposition 'until'**.
 
• The preposition ''because of'' means **as a result of; on account of**.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Correct Sentence: *Astronomers consider the year 2020 to be eventful in the celestial world **because of **the four eclipses*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The **phrase** ''**even though**'' means **despite the fact that**. (यद्यपि, हालाँकि)
 
• The preposition '**notwithstanding**' means **in spite of something**. (के बावजूद भी)

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• रेखांकित खण्ड में preposition 'until' का प्रयोग गलत है।
 
• Preposition 'until' का अर्थ है **निर्दिष्ट समय या घटना के होने तक**।
 
• दिया गया वाक्य बता रहा है कि **खगोल-विज्ञानी वर्ष 2020 को घटनापूर्ण क्यों मानते हैं**।
 
• इसलिए preposition ''because of'' का प्रयोग preposition 'until' के स्थान पर किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• Preposition ''because of'' का अर्थ है **के कारण, की वजह से, के परिणामस्‍वरूप; फलस्‍वरूप**।

 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 है।

सही वाक्य: *Astronomers consider the year 2020 to be eventful in the celestial world because of the four eclipses*.

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

__Just when I__ sit down, than the doorbell rang.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**No sooner did I**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the underlined segment, the use of the phrase 'Just when' is incorrect.
 
• The use of the word 'than' in the sentence indicates the use of the phrase ''**No sooner**''.
 
• The phrase ''**no sooner... than**'' in a sentence is used to convey that the **second event mentioned happens immediately after the first**.
 
• The **helping verb** (do, does, did, had) is placed **before the subject** (here, **I**) and the **main verb** (here, **sit**) is placed **after the subject**.
 
• Therefore, the phrase ''**No sooner did I**'' should be used in place of the phrase 'Just when'.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Correct Sentence: ***No sooner did I **sit down, than the doorbell rang*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• रेखांकित खण्ड में phrase 'Just when' का प्रयोग गलत है।
 
• वाक्य में word 'than' का प्रयोग वाक्य में phrase ''No sooner'' के उपयोग को इंगित करता है।
 
• एक वाक्य में phrase ''no sooner... than'' का प्रयोग यह बताने के लिए किया जाता है कि **उल्लिखित दूसरी घटना पहले के तुरंत बाद घटित होती है**।
 
• Helping verb (do, does, did, had) को subject से पहले रखा जाता है (यहाँ, I) और main verb (यहाँ, sit) को subject के बाद रखा जाता है।
 
• इसलिए, phrase 'Just when' के स्थान पर phrase ''No sooner did I'' का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए।

 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 है।

सही वाक्य: *No sooner did I sit down, than the doorbell rang*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage is comparing the use of mobile phones with the use of landline phones.
 
• The given sentence "***While the use of landline phones continues to decline, the ___(2)___ of mobile phone users appears to have reached a plateau, according to reports****.*'' is indicating **the decrease in the use of landline phones and increase in the use of mobile phones by people**.
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'number'.
 
• The word 'number' means **a quantity of people or things**. 
 
 
• Example:* A growing **number** of people are going vegetarian*.

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Complete Sentence: *While the use of landline phones continues to decline, the **number** of mobile phone users appears to have reached a plateau, according to reports*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **Mistake Points__**

__
 
• **Ratio and proportion cannot be used because they are used when we compare two quantities. Here, the sentence is only talking about the number of mobile phone users.**
 
• Thus, **'number'** is the correct answer.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let us explore the other options:

 
 
• 'Ratio' means **the relationship between two numbers which shows how much bigger one quantity is than another**. (अनुपात, दो संख्‍याओं के बीच संबंध जो बताता है कि एक संख्‍या दूसरी से कितनी बड़ी है)
 
• 'Proportion' means **the relationship between the size or amount of two things**. (आकार या मात्रा की दृष्टि से एक वस्‍तु का दूसरी वस्‍तु से संबंध; अनुपात)
 
• 'Figure' means **an amount in numbers or a price**. (राशि संख्‍या में या मूल्‍य)

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया अनुच्छेद मोबाइल फोन के उपयोग की तुलना लैंडलाइन फोन के उपयोग से कर रहा है।
 
• दिया गया वाक्य "*While the use of landline phones continues to decline, the ___(2)___ of mobile phone users appears to have reached a plateau, according to reports**.*'' लोगों द्वारा लैंडलाइन फोन के उपयोग में कमी और मोबाइल फोन के उपयोग में वृद्धि का संकेत दे रहा है।
 
• इसलिए, रिक्त स्थान में भरने के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द 'number' है।
 
• 'Number' शब्द का अर्थ है **व्‍यक्तियों या वस्‍तुओं की संख्‍या**।
 
 
• उदाहरण: * A growing number of people are going vegetarian*.
 
 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 है।

पूर्ण वाक्य: *While the use of landline phones continues to decline, the number of mobile phone users appears to have reached a plateau, according to reports*.
